rows.question: Can the Route10 power both of its PoE+ ports at the full 30 W per port at the same time?
rows.expected: No: 2 ports x 30 W = 60 W, but the Route10 PoE budget is 40 W
rows.answer:
The Route10 datasheet lists a total PoE budget of 40W for the router, shared across its PoE ports. [1] Each of the two 802.3at PoE+ ports is rated 54VDC at 0.6A max, which is 54 V × 0.6 A = 32.4 W per port at maximum, not 30 W. [2][4] Two ports at the full 30 W each would require 30 W (port 2) + 30 W (port 3) = 60 W, which exceeds the stated 40W total PoE budget. [1][3] Based on this evidence, the Route10 cannot power both PoE+ ports at the full 30 W per port simultaneously, since the 40W total budget is less than the 60 W required. [1][3]
